issue.title: Property handle pagination in Spring Data JPA custom queries

body:
@aureamunoz sorry, I took this one since it's something we should really have for `1.1.0` and was unlikely to have any more time this week to help out.

@uaihebert with #6068 you should be able to get around your issue. However you will either have to explicitly add a `countQuery` to `@Query`, or make the method name something that would result in select statement that would return the proper number of elements.
